lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the gill slits, transitioning from dense, smaller clusters (proximal to gills) to larger, more widely spaced centroids moving posteriorly along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-luminance bands intersect horizontal spot-rows to create a lattice-like structure, most prominent in the region between the pectoral fin insertion and the dorsal fin origin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent linear feature extending horizontally from the upper opercular region towards the caudal peduncle, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition with a specular highlight on the dorsal edge and a diffuse shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: First dorsal fin contains approximately 12-15 discrete high-luminance blobs; spacing is wider than the cephalic region, with higher density located along the anterior margin and sparse distribution towards the posterior trailing edge.
